t:
Consider the following stop loss reinsurance cover purchased by an insurer
Priority: 80% of insurance premium
Capacity: 20% of the insurance premium
Co-payment: 25% above priorityIf the total amount paid in claims is 70% of the insurance premium, what is the reinsurer's share of liability?
o: Reinsurer will not participate in payment of claims as priority level is not breached
e: Correct answer: Reinsurer will not participate in payment of claims as priority level is not breached (from the IC71 question bank).

t: In Horticulture Insurance Policy, Sum Insured is Rs 2, 00,000 and excess of Rs 30,000. Insured suffers a loss of Rs 80,000.  Calculate the  claim payable
e: Correct answer: Rs 50000 (from the IC71 question bank).

t: What are the symptoms exhibited by cattle suffering from Hemorrhagic Septicemia Cutaneous form)?
o: High fever is accompanied with diarrhoea
Hot swelling in the throat region and adjacent tissues
High fever, difficulty in respiration and protrusi
e: Correct answer: Hot swelling in the throat region and adjacent tissues (from the IC71 question bank).

t: What does pedigree of a cattle reveal?
o: Lines of ancestry of the cattle
e: Correct answer: Lines of ancestry of the cattle (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Under what conditions will "Murrah" (buffalo breed) perform best. Choose the correct option.
o: Coastal and slightly cold climatic areas
e: Correct answer: Coastal and slightly cold climatic areas (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Find the reason for high heat tolerance present in indigenous cattle. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: Indigenous cattle have a unique shape which increa
Indigenous cattle spend most of the time wallowing
The extensive area covered by the dewlap, loose body skin, more sweat glands and hair coat play a vital role in its  heat tolerance
The cool atmosphere present in India increases the
Absence of sweat glands makes indigenous cattle mo
e: Correct answer: The extensive area covered by the dewlap, loose body skin, more sweat glands and hair coat play a vital role in its  heat tolerance (from the IC71 question bank).

t: In a crop insurance program, evaluate why is it necessary to limit Government support to certain dimensions and to a certain limited period of  time.
o: To increase profitability of the program
To ensure operational effectiveness and independence are not adversely impacted
To improve program viability over time
Over dependence on Government resources could mean
Too much Government support could make the program
e: Correct answer: To ensure operational effectiveness and independence are not adversely impacted (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Ajay has opted for agriculture insurance from Delta Corp which insures him against 6 known perils. Classify this type of insurance into one of  the categories mentioned below
e: Correct answer: Multi-peril insurance (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Why were the first military farms established? Choose the most appropriate answer
o: To provide good quality fodder to cattle
To provide good quality milk and milk products to British troops
To promote the dairy industry in India
e: Correct answer: To provide good quality milk and milk products to British troops (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Compare "covered crops" and "notified crops" under NAIS. Select the statement which best describes the comparison.
o: Crops notified are with reference to actual crops covered in any implementing State / UT
Notified crops are not covered under NAIS
Covered crops need to meet yield data requirements
Covered crops are decided on past yield and notifi
e: Correct answer: Crops notified are with reference to actual crops covered in any implementing State / UT (from the IC71 question bank).

t: The franchise clause under Horticulture / Plantation (Inputs) insurance scheme is applicable to all EXCEPT:-
o: Fire losses under standard grape cover policy
Fire losses under standard citrus fruits cover pol
Fire losses under plantations cover policy
Damage of plantation crops due to flood
e: Correct answer: Fire losses under sugarcane policy (from the IC71 question bank).

t: The coefficient of yield variation for a crop in an area is upto 15%. Determine the risk group and the indemnity level under NAIS.
e: Correct answer: Low risk with 90% indemnity limit (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Where is "Kankrej" breed of cattle found?
e: Correct answer: Gujarat (from the IC71 question bank).

t: What is the premium subsidy given by the Government under SEAF(Insurance for Family Agriculture, Seguro da Agricultura Familiar)?
e: Correct answer: 75% (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Explain the term "Cross-bred bird". Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: A bird whose both parents are of Indian origin
A bird whose both parents are of foreign breed
A bird who has one parent of foreign breed and the other of Indian breed
e: Correct answer: A bird who has one parent of foreign breed and the other of Indian breed (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Ajay is a corn farmer and believes that there will be a surplus production of corn this year. How can he hedge himself against the fall in  prices due to surplus production. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: Buy a futures contract for corn in the commodities
Sell a futures contract for corn in the commodities market
Invest in a storage facility so that he can sell w
Not grow corn for the season
Sell his produce at the first opportunity he gets
e: Correct answer: Sell a futures contract for corn in the commodities market (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Which is a compulsory requirement for insurance under "Horse / Pony / Mule / Donkey Insurance Scheme"?
o: A combined certificate from the veterinarian, giving natural identification details and protective inoculation details
e: Correct answer: A combined certificate from the veterinarian, giving natural identification details and protective inoculation details (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Determine the scenario in which judgement is used to determine the premium rates. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: To adjust an existing premium rate
Setting rate for a crop where reliable historic da
Setting rate for a new crop where reliable historic data is absent
To determine premium for a policy with low exposur
To determine premium for a policy with high exposu
e: Correct answer: Setting rate for a new crop where reliable historic data is absent (from the IC71 question bank).

t: On what basis is a farmer indemnified in a crop insurance scheme based on "Individual approach"?
o: On the basis of land holding
On the basis of crop cultivated
On the basis of geographical location
On the basis of average yield for the area
On the basis of past yield and loss experience of the farmer
e: Correct answer: On the basis of past yield and loss experience of the farmer (from the IC71 question bank).

t: From the options mentioned here, point out the age group which does not represent insurable age for elephants under "Elephant Insurance  Scheme
e: Correct answer: 1-4 years (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Which of the following represents a challenge for scaling up of a weather based insurance product? Choose the most appropriate answer
o: Complex nature of the insurance product
e: Correct answer: Complex nature of the insurance product (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Explain how would catastrophic losses would be handled under NAIS?
o: Central Govt would provide all the fund needed
State Govt would provide all the fund needed
A corpus fund shall be created with contributions from the Government of India and State / Union Territory (UT) on a  50:50 basis
Money would be obtained by raising land rent taxes
Money would be obtained by recalling all agricultu
e: Correct answer: A corpus fund shall be created with contributions from the Government of India and State / Union Territory (UT) on a  50:50 basis (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Identify Exotic breed cattle from the list mentioned here.
e: Correct answer: Jersey (from the IC71 question bank).

t: State the ratio in which premium and claims were shared between central and state under PCIS.
e: Correct answer: 02:01:00 (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Ajay's suffers an accident while ploughing the fields. Classify the risk into one of the categories
e: Correct answer: Personal (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Under the standard cattle insurance scheme what is the acceptable age group for insuring milch cows. Choose the correct answer
o: 5 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years
6 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years
9 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years
2 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years
8 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years
e: Correct answer: 2 years (or age at first calving) - 10 years (from the IC71 question bank).

t: State the insurable age group for broilers under "Comprehensive cover for poultry farms".
e: Correct answer: 1 day to 8 weeks (from the IC71 question bank).

t: State the maximum sum insured for layers under "Comprehensive cover for poultry farms" in case of IRDP scheme.
e: Correct answer: Rs.25 (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Which is the main milch producing species in India?
e: Correct answer: Buffalo (from the IC71 question bank).

t: What is a likely condition caused as a result of cattle being infested by leeches?
e: Correct answer: Anaemia (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Ajay avails a loan of 90000 Rs from a commercial bank for growing millets. He gets covered under the Comprehensive Crop Insurance  Scheme. Determine the coverage applicable.
e: Correct answer: 10000 Rs (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Compare the terms "Cow" and "Heifer" and select the statement which highlights the difference (if any) correctly.
o: The terms Cow and Heifer refer to the same thing.
Cow refers to female cattle and Heifer refers to m
Cow refers to male cattle and Heifer refers to fem
Cow" refers to female cattle which has produced one or more calves and "Heifer" refers to female cattle which has yet  to produce a calf.
Cowrefers to cattle 1-2 years of age and Heifer re
e: Correct answer: Cow" refers to female cattle which has produced one or more calves and "Heifer" refers to female cattle which has yet  to produce a calf. (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Ajay has had a poor crop yield this season as a result of which he has had to scale down on the expenses for his daughter's marriage.  Classify the risk mitigation strategy exhibited.
e: Correct answer: Ex-post informal (from the IC71 question bank).

t: From the options given ,determine which one is likely to adversely affect the market response for weather based insurance.
o: High geographical spread of weather based insuranc
Easy to understand and simple product definition
Faster payouts in case of losses due to adverse we
e: Correct answer: Un-realistic expectations from clients (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Describe the indemnity offered by PROAGRO insurance program in Brazil?
o: PROAGRO indemnifies losses that exceed 30% of the expected revenue for the crop
PROAGRO indemnifies losses that exceed 90% of the
PROAGRO indemnifies the production costs if the yi
e: Correct answer: PROAGRO indemnifies losses that exceed 30% of the expected revenue for the crop (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Describe "Quota share reinsurance". Choose the most appropriate answer
o: A reinsurance agreement in which the insurer recei
A reinsurance agreement in which the insurer and reinsurer share premiums and losses using a fixed percentage
A reinsurance agreement in which the reinsurer rec
A reinsurance agreement in which the insurer bears
A reinsurance agreement in which the reinsurer bea
e: Correct answer: A reinsurance agreement in which the insurer and reinsurer share premiums and losses using a fixed percentage (from the IC71 question bank).

t: A farmer pays the same premium as the other farmers in the area and receives similar compensation irrespective of his individual loss.  Assess what approach is likely have to be used by the crop insurance scheme.
e: Correct answer: Homogenous area based approach (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Describe the purpose behind "No claim discount" under Agricultural Pumpset Insurance. Choose the most appropriate answer
e: Correct answer: Encourage better maintenance of pumpset (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Based on your knowledge of "Pig Insurance Scheme", please answer the following question. A certain pig insured for Rs 1000 under pig  insurance scheme dies due to an accident. Calculate the limit of liability for the insurer
e: Correct answer: Rs 800 (from the IC71 question bank).

t: State premium charged to cover plantation crops under Horticulture / Plantation (Inputs) insurance scheme.
e: Correct answer: 1.25% of sum insured (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Which of the following crop insurance schemes can offer automatic payout of claims?
e: Correct answer: Weather based crop insurance scheme (WBCIS) (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Which of the program(s) mentioned does not receive any federal premium subsidy in Canada?
e: Correct answer: Livestock insurance program (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Specify the reason as to why "Biomass health index" based insurance cannot work with plants like potato.
o: Biomass health index based insurance works with gr
Biomass index' is based on satellite image derived from Normalized Difference Vegetative Index (NDVI) and potato  grows underground
e: Correct answer: Biomass index' is based on satellite image derived from Normalized Difference Vegetative Index (NDVI) and potato  grows underground (from the IC71 question bank).

t: A comprehensive floriculture insurance policy is issued on market value basis and not on reinstatement basis. How does this affect the  insurer?
o: The insurer in this case will have high financial
Settlement of claim has to be done on new for old
Insurer can deduct depreciation at the time of claim sattlement
The insurers financial liability increases with ti
Insurer cannot deduct depreciation at the time of
e: Correct answer: Insurer can deduct depreciation at the time of claim sattlement (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Determine the level of indemnity offered to farmers by FIIS, if they were located in a low risk area.
e: Correct answer: 90% (from the IC71 question bank).

t: State the premium charged for the first year under Duck insurance scheme for Non-scheme animals
e: Correct answer: Rs 1.0 per bird (from the IC71 question bank).

t: PROAGRO was extensively reformulated in 2004 and two new programs were created, one was SEAF (Insurance for Family Agriculture,  Seguro da Agricultura Familiar). Name the other one.
e: Correct answer: PROAGRO MAIS (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Evaluate which of the following risks can be classified as personal
o: Farmer injured while performing agricultural operation
Unawareness regarding high yielding variety seeds
e: Correct answer: Farmer injured while performing agricultural operation (from the IC71 question bank).

t: Describe "one time" as under Duck Insurance Scheme.
e: Correct answer: Within 48 hours (from the IC71 question bank).

t: What type of insurance is required to implement the "Area based" approach?
e: Correct answer: All-peril insurance (from the IC71 question bank).
